Core Advocacy & Track Record

When your case is serious, you want an experienced advocate personally handling your matter, not a directory listing. Dr. Moksha Kalyanram Abhiramula is a Senior Advocate with more than two decades of courtroom and advisory experience, trusted by startups, MSMEs, healthcare groups, property owners and families nationwide. From high-stakes criminal defence to complex civil litigation, corporate structuring and property document verification, clients choose Dr. Moksha for clear strategy, precise drafting, and a track record of favourable outcomes — including a ₹30 Crore settlement in an intellectual property dispute. Practising before the Supreme Court of India, Dr. Moksha combines traditional courtroom advocacy with modern, tech-driven dispute resolution (e-arbitration and e-mediation) to resolve matters faster and avoid years-long court backlogs wherever possible — without ever compromising your position.

SME IPOs & Copyright Protection

As a Subject Matter Expert, Dr. Moksha structures legal frameworks for SME IPOs, investment due diligence, and regulatory compliances. In the Fashion, Media, and Entertainment sectors, he advises on safeguarding intellectual property and copyrights — including a ₹30 Crore settlement for creative producers — and authored the guide, "Art Meet Law."

Hybrid E-Arbitration & Mediation

Dr. Moksha uses tech-driven Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) — hybrid e-arbitration and e-mediation workflows with transparent, real-time digital audio-visual logging — to resolve complex commercial matters without exhausting, years-long court backlogs.

Risk Insulation & Commercial Growth

Ultimately, Dr. Moksha helps corporate innovators, healthcare providers, and creative pioneers insulate their assets from risk, avoid prolonged litigation, and achieve secure, sustainable commercial growth.

Serving Clients Across India — Chambers in Hyderabad, Telangana

Dr. Moksha's chambers are located in Begumpet, Hyderabad, representing clients across Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills, Gachibowli, Hitec City, Secunderabad and the wider Hyderabad and Ranga Reddy districts. Through Supreme Court and appellate practice, Dr. Moksha also represents clients across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh and other states nationwide. Whether you are an individual, a business, or an NRI managing matters from abroad, you get direct access to experienced legal counsel.
